headline: Executive order bans new U.S. investment in Russia and limits certain services to Russia in response to its continued aggression.
what_it_does: This order stops people and companies in the United States from making new investments in Russia. It also blocks certain kinds of services from being provided to Russia, though the title does not say which services. The order was issued in response to what it calls continued Russian aggression.

who_it_affects.how: They can no longer make new investments in Russia.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that provide services abroad
who_it_affects.how: Some may be barred from offering certain services to people or groups in Russia.

who_it_affects.group: Russian businesses and the Russian government
who_it_affects.how: They lose access to new investment money and some services from the United States.
